- Slot: Wed Sep 15 09:00–10:00 EDT works for our team. If you want the 60-minute slot, we can expand to 09:00–10:15 to cover the pen-test logistics.

2) If staging access will be required for the pen-test, please include the IP ranges and preferred auth method (SSH key / temporary credentials).
3) Share any compliance or procurement artifacts we should have on hand (POC, internal intake).

I've attached a short precall checklist that lists typical artifacts we bring to these calls (SOC2 report, network diagram, DPA excerpt, service architecture). If you confirm Wed 09:00, I'll send a calendar invite and a short runbook link for the session.
